subject: ADR-239: a name outlives the press -- every addressed control is pressed and its name read back; the door re-stamps before it resolves, and the tally cards are named by what they count, not by their count
body: ADR-188's addresses were checked when published and never a moment later. The field notebook's tally card read species-a0 and one tap made it species-a1; its task had fallen back to specGrid#0. New audit_addresses presses every addressed control of every page through the door and reads the old name back: held, gone, renamed or shadowed. Its first reading found the door itself: data-h was stamped only at observe, so a press that rebuilt a list left a just-published name answering 'no control answers to it'; _resolve now re-stamps first. Then two pages whose tally cards were named by their count (field notebook 7, farm scout 4), and steppers named only '-' and '+'. Kit: 1,632 presses, 1,615 held, 17 gone, 0 renamed, 0 shadowed. Both tasks press by name; new verify_addresses (36) and mutate_addresses (12/12).
